engine.message: Install the scanning engine to begin

rules: All scan targets are chosen by a native file/folder dialog or the fixed quick-scan profile. No browser path inputs.
Full scan opens native drive/folder selection so the user controls scope.
Call action then show errors; state broadcasts drive progress.
Watch is opt-in scanning after file changes while app runs, not real-time execution blocking.
Schedule is a daily quick scan while the app is running. No Windows service is installed.
No VPN, identity monitoring, firewall enforcement, ransomware blocking or parity claims. Explicit capability page.
Do not render raw data through innerHTML. Untrusted filenames and detection names use textContent.
Empty/unknown/partial states must never be presented as protected or clean.
